## Summary

This change tightens Exchange custody and observation: session cookies now require a caller-owned public-suffix list, typed receives zero on any close/decode failure, stream copies go through Go's `io.Copy` with per-Write panic containment, replay admits single-attempt evidence before rewriting the attempt count, and buffered responses validate merged outer+buffered framing before commit. Matching tests lock in cancellation-after-read byte retention, ReaderFrom vs WriterTo dispatch, socket header/target snapshotting, official-SDK query parse failures refusing the streaming shortcut, and exact-size secret/cgroup/release storage. The production paths I traced (receive close, write admission, replay handoff, upload file/pipe extent, buffer release, SDK query matching) behave correctly under cancellation, double-close, partial writes, and empty payloads; I did not find a correctness, security, or protocol defect worth reporting.
